newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Absa says mulls international equity offer.
newsitem.headline: Absa says mulls international equity offer.

text.p: Amalgamated Banks of South Africa Ltd (Absa) said on Tuesday it was considering an international equity offering to international investors, as previously notified to shareholders.
It said the offering would take the form of ordinary shares and Global Depositary Receipts representing ordinary shares.
Absa said it intended to use the proceeds of any such offering to refinance and expand its international operations.
A formal decision whether to proceed with the offering would be made in due course, subject to market conditions and the receipt of the necessary approvals, Absa said.
Shareholders were advised to exercise caution in their sharedealings.
